name: database_inspect
description:
Inspects a local SQLite database without changing it. Returns table names, column definitions, indexes, foreign keys, database size, and optional row counts. It opens the database read-only and never executes user-supplied SQL.
Use when: an agent needs to understand a local SQLite schema before proposing a query, migration, or data-analysis step.
Scope: local SQLite files only. Read-only.
Not for: running SQL queries or modifying data; use a separate guarded query tool when that is available. PostgreSQL, MySQL, and remote database URLs are not supported by this tool.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a local SQLite database file. Example: '/Users/me/project/data/app.db'.

include_row_counts.description: If true, count rows in each table. This can be slow for large databases. Default: false.

table.description: Optional exact table name to inspect. Omit to inspect all tables, up to 100.
